defective_pattern: Generating .md and .docx files for micro-stages but omitting or improperly naming the underlying .json data payloads.
why_defective: Violates Directive 3 (Triad Invariant & Micro-Stages). Causes cascade failure in multi-agent validation.
corrective_remedy: Atomically generate .json, .md, and .docx files with correct canonical file names for every micro-stage. Ensure parameter files like gate3 report are fully populated.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Missing .json file in 03_deliverables when .md or .docx exists for the same prefix
